message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and removes the combining marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

The same accent loss affects `src/shop/product-url.js`, which calls `vendor/slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accents like "crème" → "crme". I left it alone because you asked about blog URLs. Fixing it would take the same normalization there, or a fix in the vendored library by the platform team.

I didn't commit anything.
